purpose: Controlled CPU development check of BN estimator only; not another Real final-test evaluation or a deployable model selection.
hypothesis: Equal cumulative averages remove reset initialization and case-order EMA weighting. Whether this restores source validation discrimination must be measured, not assumed.

adaptation.input: Exactly the executed v1 adapt_normal.pt: 10 frozen original-normal Real cases, 64 windows each, 640 total.
adaptation.order: Unchanged: case_uid then window end row.
adaptation.batchnorm_mode: Reset running mean=0, variance=1, counter=0; BN train, all other modules eval; then all eval.
adaptation.CMA_semantics: Average the 10 per-case batch means and unbiased within-batch variances equally using native PyTorch momentum=null. This is NOT global pooled variance and does not include between-case mean variance.

arms.B0_source: Original source checkpoint, no target adaptation.
arms.B1_reset_ema: Recompute v1 algorithm on CPU with BN momentum=0.1, not the stored GPU-adapted state.
arms.B2_reset_cumulative: Same CPU initialization, inputs, order and operations as B1; only BN momentum changes to null (cumulative moving average).

evaluation.only_dataset: The frozen source val.pt: 35520 labeled simulation windows.
evaluation.release_or_final_claim: None; source validation is development evidence, not Real generalization. Do not tune new variants after looking at results within this run.

device: CPU only, float32, deterministic algorithms, 4 threads, seed=42
scope: Do not overwrite v1 protocol, role CSV, source cache/checkpoint, GPU outputs, or deployed assets. Any later Real evaluation needs an explicit new protocol and disclosure of previous test exposure.
